backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend canister with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: logo generation, logo display in UI, and anime-themed visual design with blue color scheme.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of frontend files describing the anime-themed OTT streaming platform UI components and styling configuration.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes using a neutral grayscale palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with title 'Star Anime OTT' and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component implementing a complete anime-themed OTT streaming platform UI with header, hero section, featured shows, trending content, and footer displaying the blue star logo.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook managing ICP actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors with automatic query invalidation on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file reserved for React Query hooks when backend integration is needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS styles with anime-themed blue color palette using OKLCH color system, custom glow effects, and grid pattern utilities for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point setting up QueryClient, InternetIdentityProvider, and rendering the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom theme extensions including OKLCH color system with CSS variables, custom font families (Inter), border radius variables, shadow utilities, and animation keyframes for accordions and other UI components.
project_state.json: Project state file tracking an OTT streaming platform with a blue star anime-themed logo, including three existing features for logo generation, display, and visual theming, plus one pending feature request.
